test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: With reference to Bhakti Saints, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Alvar Saints were the devotees of Lord Shiva.
Namdeva belonged to the Varkari Sect.
Nayanar Saints were the devotees of Lord Vishnu.
‘Bijak’ is a composition of the teachings of Saint Dadu Dayal.

solution:
**Answer: B**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The **earliest Bhakti movements** were led by the **Alvars** (**devotees of Vishnu**) and **Nayanars** (**devotees of Shiva**). They **traveled across regions**, singing **hymns in Tamil** in praise of their deities.

 
 
• ***Hence, options (a) and (c) are incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Namdeva** was a **14th-century poet-saint from Maharashtra**, associated with the **Varkari sect**.
 
 
• According to tradition, he was initially a **tailor** who later turned to **spiritual life**.
 
• He is one of the **five revered gurus** of the **Dadupanth tradition**, along with **Dadu, Kabir, Ravidas,** and **Hardas**.
 
• His **writings are included in the Guru Granth Sahib**, the **holy text of Sikhism**.
 
 
• ***Hence, option (b) is correct.***
 
 
 
 
 
• **Bijak** is the **most well-known compilation** of **Kabir’s verses** and serves as the **holy scripture** for the followers of the **Kabirpanthi tradition**.
 
 
• ***Hence, option (d) is incorrect.***
